vpw2jsva.sourceDescription: Light up your festive display with the Elverholt 6ft pre-lit artificial Christmas tree, featuring 2,127 PVC branch tips and 800 LEDs. Choose steady warm white for a softer look or multicolour for a colourful Christmas display, with eight settings also offering fading, flashing and alternating effects. The foot control lets you cycle through the functions without bending down, while hinged branches make assembly easier before you shape the tree and add your decorations. Designed for indoor use and powered from the mains, Elverholt includes a metal stand and plastic storage bag. Adult assembly required. For indoor use only. Artemis Home Ltd. 335A Torquay Road, Paignton, TQ3 2EP

4zf29saz.sourceDescription: This modern Christmas tree decoration features a unique cone-shaped design, ideal for enhancing the festive atmosphere in any room or outdoor space. Inclusive LED Lighting: Equipped with warm white LED decorative string lights that bring an elegant sparkle to your space. The warm glow offers a cozy, inviting ambiance that transforms any setting into a festive retreat. USB Connectivity: This decoration is powered via USB, offering flexible placement options. Whether it’s next to your indoor sleigh setup or enhancing your garden terrace, it seamlessly plugs into various devices for a hassle-free experience. Modern Aesthetic: With its sleek cone-shaped form and minimalist style, this decoration embodies modern decor principles. It harmonizes with both traditional and contemporary holiday displays. Simple Assembly: Requires assembly by two people, according to the manufacturer’s instructions, ensuring that every piece fits together perfectly and functions as intended. With eight lighting modes, including Combination, In Waves, Sequential, Slo-Glo, Chasing/Flash, Slow Fade, Twinkle/Flash and Steady On, you can customise the lighting to suit your festive décor. mcdv0wha.baseName: Neo Christmas Tree Stand for Real Trees - Multi
mcdv0wha.variantName: Neo Christmas Tree Stand for Real Trees - Multi
mcdv0wha.sourceDescription: Keep your real Christmas tree securely supported throughout the festive season with the Neo Extra Large Christmas Tree Stand. Designed for trees up to 2.5m (8ft 2in) tall, this sturdy stand combines a wide base with four steel legs to provide reliable support for your Christmas display. The green plastic reservoir is complemented by contrasting red steel legs for a traditional festive appearance. Four adjustable securing screws hold the tree trunk firmly in position and accommodate trunk diameters from 5cm to 14cm, making it suitable for a variety of real Christmas trees. A built-in 3.3L water reservoir allows the tree trunk to remain in water, helping you maintain your real tree throughout the Christmas period. The wide 57cm base provides additional stability while remaining compact enough for use in living rooms, conservatories and other indoor festive displays. Extra-large stand for real Christmas trees Suitable for trees up to 2.5m (8ft 2in) tall Accommodates tree trunks from 5cm to 14cm in diameter Four adjustable screws securely hold the trunk in position Four sturdy steel legs provide a wide, stable base Green plastic reservoir with contrasting red legs Built-in 3.3L water reservoir Allows the tree trunk to remain in water Suitable for indoor Christmas displays Quick and straightforward assembly Product Dimensions: H21.5 x W57 x D57cm Maximum Tree Height: 2.5m Maximum Trunk Diameter: 14cm Minimum Trunk Diameter: 5cm Water Capacity: 3.3L For use with real Christmas trees only. Adult assembly and installation required. Place the stand on a firm, level and stable surface and ensure all four legs are correctly fitted before inserting the tree. Suitable for trees up to 2.5m tall with a trunk diameter between 5cm and 14cm. Centre the trunk within the stand and tighten all securing screws evenly to ensure the tree remains upright and stable. Do not exceed the specified maximum tree height or trunk diameter. Regularly check the screws and stability of the tree throughout use and retighten if necessary. Keep the water reservoir adequately filled but do not overfill; wipe up spills immediately to prevent slip hazards and protect surrounding flooring. Keep the tree and stand away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, heaters and other direct heat sources. Do not allow children or pets to climb, pull or lean against the tree or stand. Take care when handling the metal legs and screws and discontinue use if any component becomes bent, damaged, loose or unstable. Keep small parts and packaging materials away from children. Neo Direct Ltd, Butterley Street, Leeds, LS10 1AW, United Kingdom
